text:
ravi: Heads-up: small docs bugfix PR for SOC2 section where the export CLI example used --since value in wrong format (used MM/DD/YYYY). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012

lina: Good catch. Can you also expand the note on timezones? We should say exports use UTC and any local timestamps in payloads are preserved but metadata uses UTC.

ravi: Added sentence: 'All export tooling timestamps are normalized to UTC; event payload fields retain original timezone content.' Still need SDK snippet update.

marco: From support: add note about large exports and recommended --chunk-size flag to avoid timeouts. Example: --chunk-size 10000. Also a short troubleshooting tip about 504s and the retry pattern.

ravi: Adding chunk-size example and short retry snippet for redwoodctl.

docs-bot: docs-ci: build passed for PR #1012 (:white_check_mark:).

lina: LGTM. Merging in once CI finishes.

ravi: Thanks, merging now. Will follow up with a small backport to the 1.x branch.
